candidate_scope: Unexpected scene/equipment changes and sensor disagreement
explicit_non_goals: Does not estimate safe flood depth, current, buoyancy or submerged hazards
Does not detect/identify victims by anomaly score or command a rescue robot
required_gates: Require sensor calibration, coordinate-frame and timestamp consistency
Missing returns never mean clear passage; preserve uncertainty and sensor health
Human review required; no physical actuation
no paid API, subscription, cloud GPU, model download or new dependency without explicit approval
evidence_status: documentation_only; no model accuracy, runtime integration, hardware validation or field safety is claimed
cost_policy: zero-cost-first; no external services or downloads
